outgoing.name: Extinction
outgoing.excerpt: The Passenger Pigeon (Ectopistes migratorius) is an extinct species of pigeon that was once probably the most common bird in the world .

outgoing.name: New York City
outgoing.excerpt: In New York City, in 1805, a brace (pair) of pigeons sold for two cents.

outgoing.name: North America
outgoing.excerpt: During summer, Passenger Pigeons lived throughout the part of North America east of the Rocky Mountains.

outgoing.name: United States
outgoing.excerpt: It is estimated that there were as many as five billion Passenger Pigeons in the United States.
